name: Metabase
description: Open source business intelligence and analytics platform. Create dashboards and explore data without writing SQL.
summary: Metabase is actively releasing frequent patch updates across multiple supported version branches. The latest release is v0.63.18 (open source) / v1.63.18 (enterprise), released on September 16, 2025 (https://github.com/metabase/metabase/releases/tag/v0.63.18). Multiple older branches (v0.58.x through v0.63.x) are simultaneously receiving maintenance patches, indicating long-term support across several major versions. Detailed per-release changelogs are available on the GitHub releases page but were not fully rendered in the provided changelog text.

answers.What is the current license?: Open Source edition uses AGPL v3; Enterprise edition uses a commercial license. Both are available as separate Docker images and JARs.
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases across several version branches were published in September 2025, with frequent patch cadence.
answers.Is there a cloud-hosted version availabl: Yes — Metabase offers a managed cloud (Metabase Cloud) at https://www.metabase.com.
answers.Does it support SSO and SAML authenticat: Yes — SSO and SAML are supported, typically as Enterprise/Pro features.
answers.What databases/data sources are supporte: Metabase supports many databases including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, SQLite, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, MongoDB, Presto, Druid, Oracle, Spark SQL, and more (full list at https://www.metabase.com/docs/latest/databases/connecting).

alternatives.name: Redash
alternatives.review: Open source, query-focused, simpler feature set.

alternatives.name: Apache Superset
alternatives.review: Apache-licensed, rich visualisation library, steeper setup curve.

alternatives.name: Grafana
alternatives.review: Primarily metrics/time-series but increasingly used for general BI.

alternatives.name: Hex
alternatives.review: Close source, enterprise focus, AI Analytics Platform for your whole team

alternatives.name: Tableau
alternatives.review: Tableau offers best-in-class visualizations and enterprise features but is expensive, closed-source, and overkill for teams that need Metabase's simplicity.

alternatives.name: Lightdash
alternatives.review: Lightdash is a modern open-source BI tool tightly integrated with dbt, making it ideal for data teams already using dbt but less accessible for non-technical users than Metabase.
